scientific_limitations: Only the ordinary matching complex of K1 graph-joined with a path is classified. Related triangular-strip small cases predate this result. The exact published overlap beyond indexed material cannot be formally excluded. Universal integral conclusions use a symbolic homotopy proof; enumerative tests alone would be insufficient.
title: Three-periodic integral homotopy of matching complexes of outerplanar fan graphs
